services.name: Jet Ski Tour - Mondrian South Beach Hotel
Jet Ski
services.desc: What better way to see the best that Florida has to offer than by going on a guided tour via jet ski! Operate your own personal watercraft and follow one of our knowledgeable water sports personnel through some of Florida’s most iconic waterways. These guided excursions are perfect for families and large groups (click here to inquire about our group packages!) Choose a location from the drop-down menu on the right for more information. *Tour duration varies by location Drivers born on or after January 1, 1988 must have valid proof of a Boating Safety Education ID Card As part of our commitment to safety, all renters are required to watch a brief safety video before you go out on the water.

services.name: Paddle Board
services.desc: Don’t be shy, come and try a fun and fast-growing alternative to the gym! A cross between kayaking and surfing, our stand up paddle board (SUP) rentals present a unique opportunity to enjoy some fun in the sun and on the water while also engaging your muscles for a full body workout! Our boards are designed to be simple to learn how to use and do not require any experience whatsoever to rent. So, whether you are an expert on the water or it is your first time getting your feet wet out there, you are sure to have an unforgettable experience. Ask our friendly staff for some beginners tips! Choose a location from the drop-down menu on the right for more

services.name: Banana Boats
services.desc: Climb aboard and hang on tight! Our Banana Boat ride is a popular water sports activity that offers a safe and thrilling experience all across the board. Let our licensed Captain do all the work and tow you along, while you and your mates zoom along the coastline. The ride has a capacity of 6 passengers at a time, so it is perfect for large groups looking for a fun experience on the water! One of our most popular activities! Choose a location from the drop-down menu on the right for more
